messages.subject: Canadian quantitative biologist job opportunity
parts:
Hi Folks

The Wildlife Monitoring and Assessment group of the Canadian Wildlife Service is hiring a quantitative biologist to join our team in Ottawa, Canada.

 We are looking for someone with strong quantitative skills who can contribute to the data analysis and survey design aspects of broad-scale (international, national, regional) bird monitoring programs.

 The job search closes on March 15. Applications will also be used to fill one open position (4-5 year term), as well as a pool of candidates for similar future opportunities in the Canadian Wildlife Service and Environment Climate Change Canada.

 The position is open to persons residing in Canada, as well as Canadian citizens and Permanent residents of Canada living abroad.

 Adam C. Smith                                                                                

(He,Him / Il,Lui)
